title: rewriteFrontmatterEffort insert path interpolates frontmatterBody into the repl…
description:
rewriteFrontmatterEffort insert path interpolates frontmatterBody into the replacement string passed to String.replace; a body containing $-sequences ($&, $1) would be reinterpreted. Agent frontmatter is controlled content so the risk is nil, but a replacer function would be more robust.

Source: cam/issue-87
Review round: 1

suggestion-fingerprint: e9c0c4c2586e

spec.scope: In rewriteFrontmatterEffort's insert path, replace the string-replacement interpolation of frontmatterBody (passed to String.prototype.replace) with a replacer function, so `$`-sequences ($&, $1, $$) in the body are inserted verbatim and not reinterpreted by the replace engine.
acceptanceCriteria: rewriteFrontmatterEffort's insert path uses a replacer function (not a replacement string) so `$`-sequences in frontmatterBody are inserted literally.
A test asserts a frontmatterBody containing $-sequences (e.g. `$&`, `$1`) is inserted verbatim.
Existing rewriteFrontmatterEffort behavior is otherwise unchanged; check:all is green.
gotchas: Agent frontmatter is currently controlled content so the live risk is nil; this is latent-footgun hardening.
